# IOSR Journals

> IOSR Journals is a multidisciplinary open-access academic publishing platform offering peer-reviewed journals across engineering, medical, social sciences, and humanities with NASA ADS indexing and CrossRef DOI assignment.

IOSR Journals publishes research across 15+ specialized journals including Computer Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical and Civil Engineering, and Humanities and Social Science. The platform emphasizes peer review quality, transparent indexing metrics, and global author accessibility.

## Getting Started

- [IOSR Journal Homepage](https://iosrjournals.org): IOSR homepage featuring multidisciplinary open-access academic journals
- [Why Choose IOSR](https://iosrjournals.org/why-choose.html): IOSR benefits overview: NASA ADS, CrossRef indexing, DOI assignment, peer review
- [Journal Statistics](https://iosrjournals.org/JOURNALSTATISTICS.html): Journal statistics with impact factor, citation data, and indexing metrics
- [Impact Factor 2026](https://www.iosrjournals.org/impact-factor.html): Impact factor 2026 listings and rankings by African Quality Centre for Journals

## Author Submission & Guidelines

- [Call for Papers](https://iosrjournals.org/cfp.html): Call for Papers with manuscript guidelines and publication timeline information
- [Manuscript Guidelines](https://iosrjournals.org/manuscript-guidelines.html): Manuscript submission requirements with templates, copyright forms, and guidelines
- [Manuscript Publication Guide](https://iosrjournals.org/manuscript-publication.html): Manuscript publication guide covering processing fees and payment methods
- [Peer Review Process](https://iosrjournals.org/reviewprocess.html): Peer review process explanation covering manuscript evaluation and revision

## Publication & Fees

- [How to Pay Fees](https://iosrjournals.org/how-to-pay-fees.html): Publication fee payment guide for international authors in China, India, Australia

## Metrics & Analytics

- [Portfolio Statistics](https://iosrjournals.org/stat.html): IOSR journal portfolio statistics across Computer, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics
- [Citation Reports](https://iosrjournals.org/citation.html): Citation reports and impact factor metrics for IOSR multidisciplinary journals

## Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://iosrjournals.org/faq.html): FAQ covering peer review, indexing, impact factor, and author guidelines

## Policies & Ethics

- [Publishing Ethics](https://iosrjournals.org/Ethics.html): Publishing ethics guidelines covering plagiarism, authorship, and research integrity
- [Publishing Standards](https://iosrjournals.org/publishing-statdards.html): Publishing standards for manuscript integrity, plagiarism detection, and data ethics
- [Copyright Policy](https://iosrjournals.org/copyright-policy.html): Copyright policy under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 License
